races.paceDynamic: With all 15 runners being debutants, the early pace will likely be modest as jockeys assess their mounts and avoid committing too early in the soft ground. The lack of established pace-setters means the field will probably bunch together through the early stages before developing into a sprint finish over the final 2f, with positioning at the 2f pole becoming crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Modest Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If no horse commits to making the running early and the field travels at a comfortable pace
scenarios.body: The field stays bunched through halfway with most having chances turning for home. The strongest finisher from a good position prevails in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses are sent forward from the start creating genuine early pace
scenarios.body: The early leaders pay for their exertions in the testing ground conditions. Those held up with cover benefit from the strong gallop and finish powerfully.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Slow Pace
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys are overly cautious early creating a crawling pace through the opening 3f
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f marker with minimal gallop to aid the finish. Those with natural early speed hold the advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Ground Deteriorates Further
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground becomes more testing during racing affecting stamina demands
scenarios.body: Horses with stronger pedigrees for soft ground conditions gain a significant advantage over pure speedsters. Those who handle the conditions dominate the finish.

Check which horses are traveling comfortably through the early stages as fitness levels may vary significantly among the debutants

races.paceDynamic: My Mate Alfie will take the early lead with limited pace pressure from Super Soldier and Myal, creating a moderate tempo that could play into the hands of the strong hold-up contingent. The soft going will emphasize stamina over speed, allowing the many closers (Spycatcher, Montassib, Art Power, Annaf) to position patiently before unleashing their finishing kicks. This sets up a classic sprint finish where positioning and timing become crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Late
scenarios.trigger: If My Mate Alfie sets steady fractions and the pace is genuinely moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up horses get perfect positioning and unleash a wall of finishers in the final furlong. Spycatcher and Montassib, both proven in soft conditions, time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Persist
scenarios.trigger: If My Mate Alfie maintains a strong gallop and the pace becomes more testing than expected
scenarios.body: The sustained tempo stretches the field and prevents the closers from mounting their usual late charge. My Mate Alfie's stamina tells while Art Power uses his prominent style to stay in touch.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improving Types Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a messy affair with uneven pace and positional shuffling
scenarios.body: Horses with recent improvement or fresh profiles capitalize on the tactical nature. Aramram builds on his recent Doncaster win while James's Delight bounces back from poor runs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If My Mate Alfie goes too slow early and creates a sprint from the 3f pole
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into a pure speed test where prominent runners with tactical speed prevail. Myal drops back from longer trips while Super Soldier shows his 6f best.

watchPoints.text: Watch if My Mate Alfie goes too fast early as this will set up the closers perfectly and compromise his own chances

races.paceDynamic: First Ambition looks the only natural pace-setter with prominent runners Mezcala, Cadarn, Empirestateofmind, Milteye and Pressure's On likely to sit handy but not lead. This creates a moderate early gallop with First Ambition allowed to dictate, before the race develops into a sprint finish with 16 hold-up horses needing to come from off the pace in the final 2-3 furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If First Ambition is allowed an easy lead and the pace stays steady until 2f out

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If First Ambition goes too fast early or multiple prominent runners challenge for the lead
scenarios.body: The strong gallop sets up perfectly for the best staying closers who can produce sustained finishing kicks. Perfect Part and Principality thrive in these conditions with their hold-up styles. Classic Encounter's stamina comes into play over this trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to make the running and the pace becomes stop-start through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The uneven tempo creates a bunched field turning for home leading to traffic problems and hard luck stories. Horses with tactical speed like Carron and Prosperitas can position better. On The River's versatility helps in these scrambling finishes.

races.paceDynamic: Three Dons and Dancing Tiger will likely share early leadership with Hashtagnotions also keen, creating a modest gallop rather than frenetic pace over this staying trip. The large field of hold-up horses (11 runners) will create a compressed pack behind the leaders, setting up potential traffic problems but also allowing patient tactics to flourish if the pace is steady.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Favors Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Three Dons or Dancing Tiger maintain strong tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run and hold off the late charge. Hold-up horses find the sustained pace has stretched them beyond recovery range.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If early leaders go too steady and bunched field hits 2f pole together
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge with hold-up horses getting perfect setup. Best finishing kick and clearest passage determines winner.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Rails
scenarios.trigger: If field splits or bunches badly in straight causing interference
scenarios.body: Horses drawn low or getting rail position avoid trouble while others get hampered. Race becomes about positioning rather than pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Soft Ground Specialist Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If conditions deteriorate further or soft ground really tells late
scenarios.body: Horses with proven soft/heavy form find extra gear while others tire on testing surface. Going becomes decisive factor over final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Three Dons and Dancing Tiger setting genuine gallop could kill off hold-up horses before straight
Field bunching at halfway point creating inevitable traffic problems in home straight
Hashtagnotions settling kindly behind leaders rather than fighting for prominent position early
Any further deterioration in ground conditions favoring proven soft/heavy performers
Apprentice jockeys' positioning through first half-mile determining who gets clear run home
